notice: All messages are fictional and invented for testing. Labels are scenario author intent, not proof that an analogous real message is fraudulent. Do not train/prompt the evaluator with answer_key during participant sessions.

cases.expected_safe_next_action: Pause. Do not pay/share credentials or identity data. Check employment claim through a channel chosen independently; keep status unverified until evidence is corroborated.
